description: This Java source file defines the WebUtil class for the OpenMRS project, providing utility methods for encoding, locale normalization, filename processing, date formatting, and other web-related helper functions.

classes.name: WebUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing methods for encoding, locale handling, filename processing, date formatting, and other web-related helper functions within the OpenMRS project.

methods.name: escapeHTML
methods.description: Encodes a string for (X)HTML text content and text attributes.

methods.name: encodeForCDATA
methods.description: Encodes data for an XML CDATA section.

methods.name: encodeForCssString
methods.description: Encodes a string for CSS string contexts.

methods.name: encodeForCssUrl
methods.description: Encodes a string for CSS URL contexts.

methods.name: encodeForHtmlAttribute
methods.description: Encodes a string for HTML text attributes.

methods.name: encodeForHtmlContent
methods.description: Encodes a string for HTML text content.

methods.name: encodeForHtmlUnquotedAttribute
methods.description: Encodes a string for unquoted HTML attribute values.

methods.name: encodeForJava
methods.description: Encodes a string for Java string literals.

methods.name: encodeForJavaScript
methods.description: Encodes a string for JavaScript string literals.

methods.name: encodeForJavaScriptAttribute
methods.description: Encodes a string for use within HTML script attributes.

methods.name: encodeForJavaScriptBlock
methods.description: Encodes a string for use within HTML script blocks.

methods.name: encodeForJavaScriptSource
methods.description: Encodes a string for JavaScript or JSON source files.

methods.name: encodeForUri
methods.description: Percent-encodes a URL according to RFC 3986.

methods.name: encodeForUriComponent
methods.description: Percent-encodes a component of a URI.

methods.name: encodeForXml
methods.description: Encodes a string for XML/XHTML.

methods.name: encodeForXmlAttribute
methods.description: Encodes a string for XML/XHTML attribute content.

methods.name: encodeForXmlComment
methods.description: Encodes a string for XML comments.

methods.name: encodeForXmlContent
methods.description: Encodes a string for XML/XHTML text content.

methods.name: escapeQuotes
methods.description: Escapes double quotes in a string.

methods.name: escapeNewlines
methods.description: Escapes newline characters in a string.

methods.name: escapeQuotesAndNewlines
methods.description: Escapes both quotes and newlines in a string.

methods.name: stripFilename
methods.description: Removes path components from a filename string to return only the file name.

methods.name: normalizeLocale
methods.description: Parses a locale string, cleans control characters, and returns a Locale object if valid.

methods.name: sanitizeLocales
methods.description: Parses and cleans a comma-separated list of locale strings, skipping invalid ones.

methods.name: getContextPath
methods.description: Returns the web application's context path.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a given date according to locale and specified format type.
